title: MyPaTH Story Booth
summary: The MyPaTH Story Booth will use an (audio) "document" approach to elicit in depth experiential knowledge or perspectives from patients and caregivers by recording their personal stories.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Over the age of 18

Exclusion Criteria:

* Researchers will exclude individuals who are not 18 years of age or older and/or do not provide informed consent
